command.invocation:
$oldPytestDisable = $env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD
$oldPythonUtf8 = $env:PYTHONUTF8
$oldPythonPath = $env:PYTHONPATH
$env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD = '1'
$env:PYTHONUTF8 = '1'
Remove-Item Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue
pytest -p no:asyncio tests/unit/test_alpha003_discovery_lifecycle.py -q
$testExit = $LASTEXITCODE
if ($null -eq $oldPytestDisable) { Remove-Item Env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $env:PYTEST_DISABLE_PLUGIN_AUTOLOAD = $oldPytestDisable }
if ($null -eq $oldPythonUtf8) { Remove-Item Env:PYTHONUTF8 -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $env:PYTHONUTF8 = $oldPythonUtf8 }
if ($null -eq $oldPythonPath) { Remove-Item Env:PYTHONPATH -ErrorAction SilentlyContinue } else { $env:PYTHONPATH = $oldPythonPath }
exit $testExit
